title: Data of the event ext.monitor.maintenance.v1
description: Maintenance status of a catalog node from one poll of the adapter; on the first active event of a window the core sets a stop of the scope host with the reason maintenance, and later active events move its until forward (MON-9).

maintenanceid.description: Window id in the monitoring system.

until.description: With state active: the poll time plus two poll intervals; the adapter does not compute the end of the window (MON-9).
